description.value: Your stature cuts a threatening figure, such that even a forceful breath can feel like a threat to smaller beings. You become trained in Intimidation. If you're already trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Intimidating Glare] skill feat. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to [[/act demoralize]] targets that are smaller than you.
